checks.C1: support is a contiguous index interval; first gap recorded
checks.C3: ULC / exact bivariate Lorentzianity using binomial cross-multiplication, plus C1
checks.C4: M-convex support plus every degree-2 coordinate partial Hessian has at most one positive eigenvalue; exact integer characteristic polynomials and Descartes sign changes

criterion_registration.fires: every eligible candidate subclass has fail_frac>=0.10 and none has fail_frac==0
criterion_registration.primary: A/V2/C2 for k=0; B-A/V2/C2 for k>0
criterion_registration.survival: some eligible candidate has zero failures while random_control fail_frac>=0.10

conventions.cross_tabs: raw and deduplicated; trivial codes excluded; pairwise intersections emitted when population >=20
conventions.dedup: fingerprint=(n,k,A,B,sorted complete_A); first seen is representative; provenance flags OR across members; gf4_linear means any member has it

enumerators.A: unnormalized stabilizer weight counts, always tested
enumerators.B: integer MacWilliams transform A(x+3y,x-y)/2^(n-k), tested for k>0
enumerators.B-A: non-stabilizer centralizer/logical counts, tested for k>0

flags.css_as_given: constructed as CSS / all supplied generators pure X or pure Z
flags.distance_optimal: d equals the hard-coded n<=8 best-known table
flags.even: all nonzero A support weights are even
flags.gf4_linear: k=0 and stabilizer span closed under (x,z)->(z,x XOR z)
flags.trivial: n<=2 or registered-primary V2 sequence length<=2

conventions.paulis: n-qubit Paulis modulo phase are symplectic bit pairs (x,z); phases do not affect any weight statistic
conventions.random_controls: seeded commuting-completion ensemble; generic control, not a uniform census

variants.V2: sequence from first nonzero weight >=1 through last nonzero; complete polynomial minus x_I^n; PRIMARY
variants.V2oV3: V2 slicing applied after V3 reindexing

criterion_mapping.reason: NOT FIRED: at least one eligible candidate is below theta=0.10 or has zero failures.
